desc:
🤖 Welcome to Mecha Battlegrounds!

Pilot powerful mechs and battle the enemy team for control of the battlefield! Choose your mech, customize your weapons, and work together to capture and defend beacons.

⚔️ Fight in team-based mech battles!
🔧 Equip weapons and modules to match your playstyle.
🚀 Take flight, climb walls, or lead the charge with unique mech abilities.
🎯 Capture and hold beacons to secure victory for your team!

👍 Enjoying the game? Leave a like and favorite!
